scripts.text:
[Shep]
Are you volunteering to explore the Devil's Tower?
It's extremely dangerous so you need to be at least ^4d4dffLevel 130^000000.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
你是自願去探索魔神之塔的嗎？
那裡極其危險，所以你的等級至少需要達到^4d4dff130級^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Will you come back when you get stronger?
You know what I mean right?
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
等變強些再來吧。
你明白我的意思吧？

scripts.text:
[Shep]
You want to explore again so soon?
Your body needs to recover from the time traveling.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
這麼快又想去探索？
穿越時空後，你的身體還需要時間恢復。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Take a rest day and come back tomorrow.!
You understand?
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
休息一天，明天再來！
你明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Have you rested long enough?
I am scheduled to explore today!
I have always been waiting for a member of the expedition!
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
休息夠了嗎？今天還有探索計劃！
我一直在等探險隊的成員來呢！

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
You can now re-enter the Devil's Tower.
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
你現在可以重新進入魔神之塔。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
So time and space seem to have converged there?
I'm amazed that time travel is possible.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
看來時間和空間在那裡交匯了？
時間旅行竟然真的可行，令人驚歎。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
This is all you have.
You did a good job.
I look forward to more discoveries!
Please come back tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
這就是你發現的全部了吧。
幹得不錯，期待你帶來更多發現！
明天再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Oh, you are back so soon...
Ok, I see what happened.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
哦，你這麼快就回來了...
好吧，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
This is all you have.
You did a good job.
I look forward to more discoveries!
Please come back tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
這就是你發現的全部了吧。
幹得不錯，期待你帶來更多發現！
明天再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Oh, you are back.
Let me see... you mean this tower has a passage to connect to the demon world.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
哦，你回來了。
讓我理一理...你是說，那座塔裡有一條通往魔界的通道？

scripts.text:
[Shep]
This is all you have.
You did a good job.
I look forward to more discoveries!
Please come back tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
這就是你發現的全部了吧。
幹得不錯，期待你帶來更多發現！
明天再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Are you volunteering to explore the Devil's Tower? I have been waiting for someone like you!
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
你是自願去探索魔神之塔的嗎？我一直在等待像你這樣的人！

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Finally, someone to share the mysteries of the tower for me.
No one has been volunteering up this point so I was getting worried.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
終於有人來幫我探明塔裡的秘密了。
一直沒人報名，我都快急壞了。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Please report anything you find in the tower to me.
The better the info~ the better the zeny I'll pay you!
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
在塔裡有什麼發現，都記得向我報告。
情報越有價值，我付的Zeny就越多！

scripts.text:
[Shep]
That Laphine scholar over there will open up the dimensional gap with this time device.
It is still unstable so your time for exploring will be limited.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
那邊的拉芬學者會用這臺時間裝置開啟次元裂縫。
它還不穩定，所以你的探索時間有限。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
If you are unexpectedly bounced back to here again, you should return quickly.
If you do you may or may not be able to re-enter depending on how fast you are.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
如果意外被彈回這裡，就趕快重新進去。
能不能再次進入，就看你動作夠不夠快了。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
But if you run out of time, the access to the tower will disappear.
So do you want to volunteer?
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
時間一到，通往塔裡的通道就會消失。
怎麼樣，要報名參加嗎？

scripts.text: Volunteer
scripts.translation: 自願參加

scripts.text: No Thanks
scripts.translation: 不了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Oh that's too bad
There is nothing I can do I guess.
I'll just find someone else...
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
啊，那真遺憾。
沒辦法，我再找別人吧...

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Thank you.
Okay, gather your party and remember to report to me what you find.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
謝謝。
好的，召集你的隊伍，記得向我報告你的發現。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
^4d4dffExploring time limit is for your safety^000000!
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
^4d4dff探索時間限制是為了你們的安全^000000！

scripts.text:
[Shep]
You seem to be late.
You took an extraordinarily long time.
.....
I can't use any of your info.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
你好像回來晚了，花的時間實在太長。
...
這些情報我一條也用不上。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
There is nothing we can do .
There's always opportunities for other expeditions.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
我們無能為力。
總會有其他探險的機會。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
First of all, you need to reserve a queue at the gate.
The Laphine Scholar Artie will reserve your queue for you.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
首先得在入口預約。
找拉芬學者阿蒂，他會幫你安排。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Time is limited because the dimensional gap is still unstable.
Make your exploration short and sweet.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
次元裂縫還不穩定，探索時間有限。
進去後要抓緊時間，速去速回。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Rewards will be different depending on your time.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
獎勵會根據你探索所用的時間而有所不同。
祝你好運！

scripts.text: Trust me!
scripts.translation: 相信我！

scripts.text: Cancel my reservation
scripts.translation: 取消我的預約

scripts.text:
[Shep]
I believe that you can manage under these restrictions.
I believe in you!
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
我相信你能在這些限制下完成任務。
加油！

scripts.text:
[Shep]
You seem to be tired of exploring.
^4d4dffIf you cancel now. You will be able to challenge one day after.^000000
Is that okay?
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
你似乎對探索感到厭倦了。
^4d4dff如果你現在取消，一天後就可以再次挑戰。^000000
這樣可以嗎？

scripts.text: Yes Cancel.
scripts.translation: 是的，取消

scripts.text: Wait, don't cancel!
scripts.translation: 等等，別取消！

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Ok, I won't cancel.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
好的，我不取消。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Really.
then, come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
好吧，那明天再來。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Really?
After listening to all this explanation?
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
真的嗎？
聽完這些解釋之後？

scripts.text:
[Artie]
let's have fun since we just left bifrost.
No?
you are applying as a volunteer?
You'd better gather a party for this expedition.
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
剛離開彩虹橋，就先好好玩玩吧。
咦？你是來報名參加探索的？
那最好先召集一支隊伍。

scripts.text:
[Artie]
Don't take any unncessary risks, okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
不要冒不必要的風險，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Artie]
Bring the Expedition Chief.
Devil's Tower is not a place to visit alone.
Bring the manager.
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
請叫探險隊長過來。
魔神之塔可不能一個人去，讓負責人來吧。

scripts.text:
[Artie]
You have already entered by connecting it.
Connect to the space again? I can not do that.
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
已經連線過，也送你進去了。
要我再次連線那個空間？這可辦不到。

scripts.text:
[Artie]
Hrm... It is difficult to connect to unless it is an appointed exploration time.
Not to mention dangerous as well.
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
嗯...不在規定的探索時間內，很難建立連線，而且也很危險。

scripts.text:
[Artie]
Are you a volunteer to explore the Devil's Tower?
Do you want me to activate the Dimensional Device?
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
你是來申請探索魔神之塔的志願者嗎？
需要我啟動次元裝置嗎？

scripts.text:
[Artie]
Decide quickly because you only have a finite amount of time in there.
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
快點決定吧，能待在裡面的時間可有限。

scripts.text: Yes, activate the device.
scripts.translation: 是的，啟動裝置

scripts.text: Wait for a minute.
scripts.translation: 稍等一下

scripts.text:
[Artie]
Your time to explore is dwindling.
Time is very important.
What are you waiting for?
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
你的探索時間所剩無幾了。
時間非常寶貴。
你還在等什麼？

scripts.text:
[Artie]
The Dimensional Device is activated.
If you're lucky, you can get through this quickly.
I look forward to hearing good news.
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
次元裝置已經啟動。
順利的話，很快就能過去。
等你的好訊息！

scripts.text:
[Artie]
Hey, Hey
It is difficult to send to you through the device right now.
We should stop exploring today and let's go again another day.
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
喂，喂！現在沒法用裝置送你過去。
今天的探索就到這裡，改天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Artie]
Look, I am sorry but it is not allowed to enter except during the allowed time, Devil's Tower is dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
抱歉，魔神之塔太危險，只能在規定時間內進入。

scripts.text:
[Artie]
Yes, this is the Dimensional Device.
It is used to travel time.
It will be difficult to enter again if you leave.
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
沒錯，這就是用來穿越時空的次元裝置。
離開之後，想再進去可就難了。

scripts.text:
[Artie]
Don't worry though, I'm a genius scholar~
Anyway, ready to enter?
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
別擔心，我可是天才學者~
總之，準備好進去了嗎？

scripts.text: Enter the device.
scripts.translation: 進入裝置

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Artie]
Right.
It seems like quite a long time has passed since you activated the device. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
嗯，裝置啟動後，好像已經過了很久了吧？

scripts.text: An unknown error occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生了一個未知錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
The Dimensional Device needs to be activated first before entering.
It doesn't seem to be activated yet.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
次元裝置需要先啟動才能進入。
看起來它還沒有啟動。

scripts.text:
[Shep]
Please get a permission to activate it by talking to the Magic Scholar Artie.
scripts.translation:
[謝普]
請找魔法學者阿蒂獲取啟動許可。

scripts.text:
[Artie]
Exploring Devil's Tower will be permitted only for expeditions in parties.
Make sure you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[阿蒂]
探索魔神之塔僅允許以隊伍形式進行。
請確保你已做好準備。

scripts.text:
[Officer Heim]
Who brought you all here?
I will talk to a representative.
scripts.translation:
[軍官 海姆]
是誰帶你們來的？
讓負責人來和我談。

scripts.text:
[Officer Heim]
Back up soldiers? So why are you just standing there?
scripts.translation:
[軍官 海姆]
你們是援軍？那還愣著幹什麼？

scripts.text: Right now?
scripts.translation: 現在嗎？

scripts.text:
[Healer Fama]
Commander please help me. I can't do it by myself~!
scripts.translation:
[治療師 法瑪]
指揮官，請幫幫我。我一個人做不到~！

scripts.text:
[Officer Heim]
Do you hear that?
Help Fama take care of the injured soldiers.
Fama will give you first aid-kits, use it to help the injured people.
scripts.translation:
[軍官 海姆]
你們聽到了嗎？
請協助法瑪救治受傷計程車兵。
法瑪會提供急救箱，請用它來幫助傷者。

scripts.text:
[Officer Heim]
It is priority to treat the injured soldiers by assisting Fama.
Please do your best even if the environment is the worst.
scripts.translation:
[軍官 海姆]
協助法瑪救治受傷計程車兵是當務之急。
即使環境惡劣，也請竭盡全力。

scripts.text:
[Officer Heim]
Luckily, no one is dead yet.
I do not want to see my soldiers die.
scripts.translation:
[軍官 海姆]
幸運的是，目前還沒有人陣亡。
我不希望看到我計程車兵死去。

scripts.text:
[Healer Fama]
Please cure the injured with this first aid kit.
It's not difficult. Just follow the instructions.
scripts.translation:
[治療師 法瑪]
請用這個急救箱治療傷者。
這並不難，只需按照說明操作即可。

scripts.text:
[Healer Fama]
We are low on supplies. So I will give them once at a time.
Sorry, please request again if you run out.
scripts.translation:
[治療師 法瑪]
物資緊缺，每次只能發一個。
抱歉，用完了再來領吧。

scripts.text:
[Healer Fama]
Sorry... procurement is not good right now so I can only provide one first-aid kit at a time.
Please request again if you run out.
scripts.translation:
[治療師 法瑪]
抱歉...眼下補給不足，每次只能給你一個急救箱。
用完了再來領吧。

scripts.text:
[Healer Fama]
Huh... Okay, we can take a break now.
Thank you very much!
scripts.translation:
[治療師 法瑪]
呼...終於能歇口氣了。
真是太感謝你了！

scripts.text: I need 1 first-aid-kit to treat the injured soldier.
scripts.translation: 我需要1個急救箱來治療這名受傷計程車兵。

scripts.text:
This soldier has lost consciousness and groaning.
Should I use the first-aid kit?
scripts.translation:
這名士兵已經失去意識，正在呻吟。
我要使用急救箱嗎？

scripts.text: Use first-aid kit.
scripts.translation: 使用急救箱

scripts.text: Observe condition.
scripts.translation: 觀察狀況

scripts.text: You decide to observe the condition of the injured soldier more.
scripts.translation: 你決定更仔細地觀察這名受傷士兵的狀況。

scripts.text: You administer the first-aid-kit to the soldier.
scripts.translation: 你為這名士兵使用了急救箱。

scripts.text: It worked.
scripts.translation: 起效了。

scripts.text:
[Injured soldiers]
whew.. it seems to be okay now.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[受傷計程車兵]
呼...看來沒事了。
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Injured soldiers]
Groaning... Just let me die.
No it hurts too much.
scripts.translation:
[受傷計程車兵]
呃啊...讓我死了吧...
不行，太疼了。

scripts.text:
[Injured soldiers]
His conscious seems to be blur still.
Leave him to get some rest.
scripts.translation:
[受傷計程車兵]
他的意識似乎還是很模糊。
讓他休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Injured soldiers]
I thought I was going to die.
But I'm alive!
scripts.translation:
[受傷計程車兵]
我以為我要死了。
但我還活著！

scripts.text:
[Injured soldiers]
I can't die here. I have to propose to my beloved when I get home.
We will be happy for sure?
scripts.translation:
[受傷計程車兵]
我不能死在這裡。等我回家，一定要向心愛的人求婚。
我們一定會幸福的吧？

scripts.text:
[Injured soldiers]
I feel much better but I still can't move.
Still I'm lucky to be alive.
scripts.translation:
[受傷計程車兵]
我感覺好多了，但還是動不了。
不過能活著真是太幸運了。

scripts.text:
[Injured soldiers]
Thank you.. Thank you..
scripts.translation:
[受傷計程車兵]
謝謝你...謝謝你...

scripts.text:
[An aide]
The calamity that happened hundreds of years ago will not happen again right?
Why have the demons showed up again so suddenly?
scripts.translation:
[一名副官]
數百年前發生的災難不會再次發生，對吧？
為什麼惡魔會突然再次出現？

scripts.text:
[A tirailleur]
Are you a member of back-up team?
Good. things are getting worse here.
Glad that you all are here to help.
scripts.translation:
[一名散兵]
你們是增援部隊？太好了，這裡的情況越來越糟。
幸好有你們來幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
Who is in charge of the back-up team?
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
增援部隊是誰負責的？

scripts.text:
[Dewey]
I will guide you to the upper floor.
Do not forget to get rid of any demons that you encounter on the way.
scripts.translation:
[杜威]
我會指引你們去樓上。
路上遇到惡魔時，別忘了消滅它們。

scripts.text: Move now
scripts.translation: 現在出發

scripts.text: I need more time to prepare.
scripts.translation: 我需要更多時間準備

scripts.text:
[Dewey]
Be prepared for anything.
scripts.translation:
[杜威]
做好應對任何情況的準備。

scripts.text:
[Dewey]
Travel carefully.
scripts.translation:
[杜威]
路上小心。

scripts.text:
[Louie]
The Captain says that we need to get rid of all of the demons...
Better get to it.
scripts.translation:
[路易]
隊長說，要把所有惡魔清除乾淨...
趕快動手吧。

scripts.text:
[Louie]
A lot of soldiers still survived the attacks.
They got rid of all the demons.
scripts.translation:
[路易]
很多士兵在襲擊中倖存了下來。
他們消滅了所有的惡魔。

scripts.text:
[Louie]
I was making sure that no one goes upstairs, I was afraid something might happen again.
scripts.translation:
[路易]
怕再出什麼事，我一直守著，不讓人上樓。

scripts.text:
[Louie]
I wish you would help me.
I will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[路易]
希望你能幫幫我。
我會指引你。

scripts.text: I have been exploring the passages of this tower for a while now.
scripts.translation: 我已經探索這座塔的通道一段時間了。

scripts.text: You wave your hand in front of her but she doesn't react.
scripts.translation: 你在她面前揮手，但她沒有反應。

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
I am sorry if I'm giving you any attitude but I can't move.
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
抱歉，不是故意怠慢你，我現在動不了。

scripts.text: Can I help?
scripts.translation: 我能幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
I can use self-recovery but I don't have time for that.
Will you share your power with me?
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
我可以自行恢復，可眼下沒那個時間。
能借用你的力量嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
I need your help to activate my restoration system.
Please hold tight.
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
得藉助你的力量啟動修復系統。
請堅持一下。

scripts.text:
Lucile seems to be a machine.
I can hear mechanical sounds all of a sudden.
System is restored.
scripts.translation:
露西爾似乎是機械構造，體內突然傳來機械運轉的聲響。
系統恢復了。

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
Wow! You fixed it faster than I thought.
Did that surprise you?
I have to be fixed occasionally because I don't have a normal body
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
哇！比我想的修得還快。
嚇到你了？我的身體和常人不同，偶爾就得修一修。

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
This body was a gift from the gods.
Do you see the gate in the middle?
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
這具身體是神明賜予的禮物。
你看到中間的那扇門了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
Hurry up or this world will be in a danger.
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
快一點，否則這個世界就會陷入危險。

scripts.text:
[Huey]
I am concerned about her.
It happens whenever she's wounded.
Because she's mostly machine...
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
我很擔心她。
每次她受傷都會這樣。
因為她大部分是機械構造...

scripts.text:
[Huey]
I know the path upstairs...
First of all, we have to get rid of these demons!
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
我知道通往樓上的路...
首先，我們必須消滅這些惡魔！

scripts.text:
[Huey]
I wonder how the others are doing...
Only Thanatos and Lucile have ever entered to upper floor...
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
不知道其他人怎麼樣了...
只有薩納托斯和露西爾進入過樓上...

scripts.text:
[Huey]
If you want to assist them, you must hurry.
I will guide the way for you.
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
如果你想支援他們，必須快點。
我會為你帶路。

scripts.text: Move immediately.
scripts.translation: 立刻出發

scripts.text: Do not follow.
scripts.translation: 不跟隨

scripts.text:
[Huey]
...I see.
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
...我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Huey]
This way.
Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[休伊]
這邊請。
小心點。

scripts.text:
[Magic Swordman Thanatos]
I am sorry but I have been through tough time...
scripts.translation:
[魔劍士 薩納托斯]
抱歉，我剛經歷了一場苦戰...

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
I am talking to your party leader now so please step back for a while.
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
我正在與你的隊長交談，請暫時退後一下。

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
Oh. You just have arrived in time.
Do you want to take a look over there?
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
哦，你來得正好。
要去那邊看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
We need to stop the demon...
Can you do that?
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
我們需要阻止那個惡魔...
你能做到嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
We need to hold this spot until the trap is set by the Magic Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
我們需要守住這裡，直到魔劍士設下陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
I guess the power of Demon Morocc to break the shield of seal has collided with Thanatos.
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
大概是夢羅克為了衝破封印而釋放的力量，與薩納托斯的力量發生了碰撞。

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
It has gone too far somewhere in the south
Will you go there?
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
那股力量一路衝向了南方很遠的地方，你要過去看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
The collision of those two powers is too much to handle.
It could have influenced the south of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
兩股力量碰撞的威力太強了，恐怕連盧恩·米德加茲南部都受到了影響。

scripts.text: Follow.
scripts.translation: 跟隨

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
...I guess this is what you are able to?
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
...看來你只能做到這裡了？

scripts.text:
[Lucile]
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[露西爾]
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Young Girl]
Why are there demons in the castle?!
HELP ME!
scripts.translation:
[年輕女孩]
為什麼城堡裡會有惡魔？！
救救我！

scripts.text:
[Young Girl]
*weeping* The demons are so scary.
scripts.translation:
[年輕女孩]
嗚嗚...惡魔好可怕。

scripts.text:
[Young Girl]
Why would demons come all of a sudden,
lots of guards are hurt.
scripts.translation:
[年輕女孩]
惡魔怎麼突然就來了？好多衛兵都受傷了。

scripts.text: Where are they?
scripts.translation: 它們在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Young Girl]
They are in Morocc castle. My father is a knight.
scripts.translation:
[年輕女孩]
它們在夢羅克城堡。我的父親是一位騎士。

scripts.text:
[Young Girl]
It seems like something is happening, I hear strange noises downstairs.
scripts.translation:
[年輕女孩]
好像有什麼事發生了，我聽到樓下有奇怪的聲音。

scripts.text:
[Young Girl]
I saw some guys in black entering. What is going on in the castle?
scripts.translation:
[年輕女孩]
我看到幾個黑衣人進來了。城堡裡到底發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Young Girl]
Papa.. Papa please be safe. *sob*
Please come with me through the passage behind that shelf!
scripts.translation:
[年輕女孩]
爸爸...爸爸一定要平安啊...嗚嗚...
請跟我走架子後面的通道！

scripts.text:
[Young Girl]
Behind that shelf is a secret passage to the basement!
Please come with me to make sure my Papa is safe.
scripts.translation:
[年輕女孩]
那個架子後面有一條通往地窖的秘密通道！
請跟我來，我要確認爸爸是否安全。

scripts.text:
[Young Girl]
From here.. I do not know well...
I see so many stairs...
See there are so many demons. My father will be in a danger!
Please save him.
scripts.translation:
[年輕女孩]
這邊...我不太熟悉...樓梯好多...
看，好多惡魔！爸爸有危險！快救救他。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Lord Knight]
You were the rats who were sneaking around here!
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克騎士領主]
你們就是那些在這裡鬼鬼祟祟的老鼠！

scripts.text:
[Loki]
You have no power here.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
這裡沒你的事。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I am talking to your boss.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我在跟你們的頭兒說話。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
...embarrassing.
You should ^4d4dffTerminate the mercenary contract^000000, if you want to help me on this mission.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
...真麻煩。
想幫我完成這次任務，就先^4d4dff解除傭兵契約^000000。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Where did you come from?
I may need help here.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
你從哪裡來？
我可能需要你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
The Lord Knight is no longer human. I have to send him to his eternity for his demonic followings.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
騎士領主已經不是人類了。
既然追隨了惡魔，就讓我送他長眠吧。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
^4d4dffThe ones who are infernally blessed by demons are invincible. We can sever the blessing with Mind Blaster.^000000
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
^4d4dff受到惡魔加護的傢伙是無敵的，不過可以用心靈淨化切斷加護。^000000

scripts.text:
[Loki]
You will be in charge of activating Mind Blaster.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
你將負責發動心靈淨化。

scripts.text:
^4d4dffLoki, Guillotine Cross of the Assassin Guild, has joined your party.
We have to get rid of the demonic Lord Knight by Mind Blasting him with Loki's skill.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff刺客公會的十字斬首者洛基加入了你的隊伍。
我們必須用洛基的技能心靈淨化來消滅被惡魔附身的騎士領主。^000000

scripts.text:
[Loki]
.. annoying
The demon was destroyed before the resurrection ceremony was completed.
Things will be fine for awhile.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
...真麻煩。
復活儀式完成前，惡魔就被消滅了。
暫時應該沒事了。

scripts.text: I have gained unexpected information during my exploration of the Tower.
scripts.translation: 探索魔神之塔時，我意外獲得了一些情報。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I will remain apart from my conscience for a bit longer
someday I'll let myself feel again, and today will occupy my thoughts..
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我還得再將良知擱置一段時間。
等哪天能重新正視自己的感受，我會想起今天的事...

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Interesting.. there is a daughter..
What should be done about it?
I am not sure of what my next move is to be..
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
有意思...竟然還有個女兒...
該怎麼辦呢？我也不知道下一步該怎麼做...

scripts.text:
[Loki]
But no matter, you obviously shouldn't be here, now.
Will stay here any longer?
I can send you back where and when you belong.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
不過，這和你無關，你本就不該出現在這個時空。
還想再待會兒嗎？我可以送你回到屬於你的時間和地方。

scripts.text: Get out of here.
scripts.translation: 離開這裡

scripts.text: Take a look around.
scripts.translation: 四處看看

scripts.text:
[Loki]
It is unwise to linger where time is distorted.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
在時間扭曲的地方逗留是不明智的。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Perhaps, our missions will ally us again in the future..
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
也許，在未來的任務中，我們還會再次並肩作戰...
